description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ExternalEventConfigurationNotFoundException' used in the Fineract project to signal missing external event configurations.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a specific external event configuration was not found.

methods.name: ExternalEventConfigurationNotFoundException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message.

methods.name: ExternalEventConfigurationNotFoundException(String externalEventType)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating which external event type was not found.
